import bisect

def main():
    n = int(input().strip())
    v = list(map(int, input().split()))
    k = int(input().strip())
    
    v.sort()
    
    res = 1
    for i in range(n):
        # Find the upper bound for v[i] + k starting from index i
        j = bisect.bisect_right(v, v[i] + k, lo=i)
        length = j - i
        if length > res:
            res = length
    
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
